# Jester

> A plain-text notepad for 64-bit Windows 10 and 11 that keeps every tab, saved or not, across restarts and crashes.

Jester is one portable file, Jester.exe, with the .NET runtime bundled. There is no installer, no account and no update check.
It opens files in tabs, finds and replaces, searches every file in a folder and exports a tab to an A4 PDF.
Preferences and unsaved tabs are stored in %AppData%\Jester.
Files given on the command line open as tabs. There are no command-line flags and no automation interface.

## Download

- [Jester for Windows](/download/windows): the latest Jester.exe for 64-bit Windows 10 and 11. If Windows says it protected your PC, click More info, then Run anyway.

## Agent skill

- [Skill](/skill/jester.zip): the jester skill folder in the Agent Skills format, to add to an AI assistant.
- [SKILL.md](/skill/jester/SKILL.md): the skill's instructions as plain Markdown: features, shortcuts, settings, files, install, update and removal.
